人设不能崩（人设不能崩（第22页）“噢，这么说你恢复记忆了？”周通目光如炬，周身散发出微妙的压迫感。“不，还没完全，但我可以肯定，在我巅峰时刻，就算是帝兵也要避我锋芒，我的主人…对，一定不会错的，不是准帝，而是真正的大帝…”“他说的或许是真的…”突然间，体内传来了久违的声音。“镜子，你什么时候来的？”“我一直在你身边，从未走远！”“够了，少贫嘴，这个家伙真有那么了不起吗！”“你看不出来那是正常的，他的来历不小，也仅比我低半个档次。”“你知道的，我是先天帝兵，是所有帝兵之中最顶尖的存在，而他，也是准先天神材，体内帝道法则虽然缺失，却残留着明显的大道痕迹。”“这证明在他巅峰时期，所蕴藏的帝道法则已经达到了充沛完满的程度，若有真正的大帝祭炼，轻而易举的就能踏入无上帝兵的行列，足以紧排在我后面了。”镜子洋洋得意的自卖自夸，忽然间，语气一顿。“这就很奇怪了，都走到了这一步，竟然硬生生的停住了，简直就是暴殄天物，没有哪个大帝会舍得这样做的！”“大帝？！”“没错，他应该没有说谎话，他的主人的确踏入了那个领域，却都来不及助他终极一跃，只能猜测有什么可怕的事情突然降临，强行阻断了这个过程！”周通心头一震，就连四尊斩麟境都说可怕了，或许是真的很可怕。“喂…你在干什么，怎么突然就呆住了，跟个木头似的，难道是走火入魔了，那就别怪我不客气了，砸碎你的脑门了！”准帝兵见周通呆滞，顿时喜出望外，这个万恶的家伙终于不能再钳制他了。然而话音刚落，一只手直接抓住瓶颈，狠狠的捏住。“你在说什么？”“要死了要死…你想把我捏碎吗，快松手，你知不知道你手劲有多大！”对方咆哮道，轻轻的震动着，精神波动却始终注视着反抗军大营的那个方向。“那个女人，你要救下她！”“你说的是青灵吗？”周通轻挑眉头问道。“除了她，还能是谁？”“虽然我原本就打算这么做，但你都命令我了，我就要问一句凭什么了！”“这说不清楚，但我有一种感觉，总觉得她很熟悉，总之就是很特别！否则的话，也不可能被天道点名，专门要吞噬她。”“你说的有道理…”周通微微点头，很明显，黄远对青灵这份黑暗之力格外的上心，甚至到了如履薄冰，谨小慎微的地步。一个大圣如此卑微，本来就不寻常。正好，他也想试试天道的斤两了！…“黑暗本源进进进…”大营中，黄远手持黑瓶，口朝下底儿朝天，轻轻的念动了咒语，下一刻，瓶口就爆发出了强大的吸力，要将一团光芒掠夺入其中！

The character cannot be destroyed (The character cannot be destroyed (Page 22) "Oh, so you have recovered your memory?" Zhou Tong's eyes were blazing, and there was a subtle sense of oppression all over his body. "No, it's not complete yet, but I can be sure that at my peak, even the emperor's soldiers will avoid my edge. My master... Yes, he must be right, not the quasi-emperor, but the real emperor..." "Maybe what he said is true..." Suddenly, a long-lost voice came from the body. "Mirror, when did you come?" "I've always been by your side, never far away!" "That's enough, stop talking, is this guy really that amazing?" "You can't tell that it's normal. His background is not small, and he is only half a level lower than me." "You know, I am an innate emperor's soldier, the top among all emperors, and he , is also a quasi-innate divine material. Although the Imperial Law in his body is missing, there are still obvious traces of the Great Dao. "This proves that at his peak, the Imperial Law contained in him has reached a sufficient and perfect level. If he has a true emperor's sacrifice, he can easily step into the ranks of the godless soldiers, enough to rank behind me." Jing Jing boasted proudly, and suddenly his tone stopped. "This is very strange. He has come to this step and stopped abruptly. It is simply a waste of resources. No great emperor would be willing to do this!" "Great Emperor?!" "Yes, he must not be lying. His master did step into that realm, but he was too late to help him make the final leap. We can only guess that something terrible happened suddenly and forcibly blocked this process!" Zhou Tong's heart was shaken. Even the Four Killing Lin Realm said it was scary. Maybe it was really scary. "Hey... what are you doing? Why did you suddenly freeze like a piece of wood? You are possessed. Then don't blame me for being rude and smashing your head!" Seeing Zhou Tong's sluggishness, the quasi-emperor soldier was overjoyed. This evil guy could no longer restrain him. However, as soon as he finished speaking. He grabbed the bottleneck with one hand and squeezed it hard. "What are you talking about?" "You want to crush me to death? Let go, do you know how strong your hand is!" The other party roared, shaking slightly, but always looking in the direction of the resistance camp. "That woman, you have to save her!" "Are you talking about Qing Ling?" Zhou Tong asked with a raised eyebrow. Who else could she be? ""Although I originally planned to do this, you ordered me, so I have to ask why!" "I can't explain it, but I have a feeling that she is very familiar, in short, she is very special! Otherwise, it is impossible for Tiandao to name her specifically..." Zhou Tong nodded slightly. It was obvious that Huang Yuan was attracted by Qing Ling's darkness. He is extremely cautious, even walking on thin ice. It is unusual for a great sage to be so humble. It just so happens that he also wants to try the power of heaven! ..."The source of darkness enters..." In the camp, Huang Yuan held the black bottle with his mouth facing the sky and gently chanted the spell. The next moment, a powerful suction force erupted from the bottle mouth, trying to plunder a ball of light into it!
